metadata.scope: The data states the auth mind map behaviours require: run personas, the OTP sign-in fixtures, disposable lockout and block accounts, the VCST-6132 case-created buyer and its membership states, the impersonation personas, and the store and platform switches (OTP, MFA, sign-in log).
metadata.built_from: /qa-test-data-model build auth, 2026-10-21 — no live observation; seeders and aliases read at source, suite Preconditions read for the informal contract
metadata.known_limit: MFA requirements are PR-stage (vc-module-mfa#1) and every MFA state is a SEEDER GAP: there is no dedicated MFA store or account, and the switches are shared by every suite that signs in.

requirements.purpose: The store every OTP case signs in to, with code sign-in switched on.
requirements.discriminates: On, the default /sign-in view is the code form and POST /api/otp/request answers succeeded; data.auth.store.otp-disabled is the same store with the switch off, so the pair decides the OTP-off branches.
requirements.limits: Environment configuration: no seeder sets it. B2B-store holds it on both stands today (vcst, vcptcore_qa1). A setting saved through settings v2 can reach the Stores API minutes late (KB-5B1912FA, suspected defect), so a case that just restored it polls the storefront before relying on it.

evidence.note: OtpSignIn.Enabled true on B2B-store on vcst and vcptcore_qa1; every other store false or unset

requirements.purpose: The run store with code sign-in switched off for the duration of one case.

relationships.note: the case flips the shared store and restores it

cleanup.via: the case's Cleanup switches OtpSignIn.Enabled back on and polls /sign-in (or /api/otp/request) until the code form returns

requirements.discriminates: Same store, same account, switch off: /sign-in shows only the password form and the API refuses with otp_disabled, against the code form and succeeded with the switch on. The pre-feature behaviour an existing store relies on.
requirements.limits: Store-wide toggle on the shared run store: every OTP case in 104 and 105 and the VCST-6132 cases read it, so OTP-007 and OTP-022 run alone. It does not break [PRE:SIGNIN_AS], whose password form becomes the default view.

evidence.note: POST /api/otp/request on a store with OTP off answers otp_disabled
Automated; flips and restores the setting

requirements.purpose: An address no account on the stand uses.

requirements.purpose: The run persona: a storefront Customer of the run store that signs in by password or by code.

relationships.note: only the code sign-in needs it

requirements.shared_state: Its failed-attempt counter, its lock, its current organization and its sessions are shared by every storefront suite that signs in as the run user. A case that types a wrong password or code (AUTH-018, OTP-018) moves the counter and must zero it with one good sign-in; locking it is never allowed. On vcst it is the same login as SUPPORT_AGENT, 082's operator.
requirements.discriminates: The account that does exist, next to data.auth.input.unknown-email that does not, and next to the trusted, foreign and no-store contacts that differ from it only in their store.
requirements.limits: A different account per stand (vcst: b2b/users.csv USR-001; vcptcore_qa1: a personal account), so nothing about its organization is asserted. Its password is the env value, not a seeded one.

evidence.note: the committed per-env binding
Precondition: a contact of STORE_ID with lockout enabled and a non-expired password

requirements.purpose: The platform administrator: reads the notification journal and the sign-in log, flips settings, locks and unlocks accounts, signs in to the Admin.
requirements.discriminates: The store-less account: it signs in to the Admin without a storeId while a storefront contact is refused there, and it is the target an operator should not reach (impersonation no-target-guard).
requirements.limits: Never a lockout or block fixture. On vcst it is lockable and was temporarily locked repeatedly on 2026-10-21 by other callers (domain map G12, KB-262ADDFB): a case finding it locked is BLOCKED, not FAIL. On vcptcore_qa1 lockoutEnabled is false, which makes the OTP grant refuse it (lockout_disabled), so it cannot decide the OTP admin-exempt branch.

profiles.notes: A wrong password on the run persona moves its shared failed-attempt counter: one good sign-in afterwards zeros it.
Decidable only where the run store requires verification (vcptcore_qa1 today).
A replay that the product refuses records a failed attempt on the shared run persona: the case zeros the counter with one good grant.
Needs PasswordLogin:DetailedErrors off, which no stand runs today (both on, domain map D11): not decidable on vcst or vcptcore_qa1 until it is.
Also needs a homepage CMS block carrying the login section, which neither stand renders (domain map G19); no data model entry until a seeder builds one.
The VCST-6132 cases sign in by code, so they also need data.auth.store.otp-enabled; it is outside this node's closure because the fallback is the same for every credential grant.
Variant: the unusable organization is locked (a status-blocked one is not listed).
Variant: the NON-active organization is blocked mid-session; the refresh token is minted after the change.
Two states in order: Org A locked (fallback writes Org B), then Org B locked too.
Both targets are RESERVED: read-only, never unlocked or confirmed.
The operator is the administrator and the target the case-created buyer, not the 082 personas.
The run persona signs in by password and by code to produce one row per method; the administrator reads them.
